description: This file defines a React component for a login page with a two-step authentication flow, including fetching user organizations by email and handling login with organization and password. It uses React hooks, external API calls, and UI components.

methods.name: handleFindOrgs
methods.description: Handles fetching organizations associated with the entered email, updating state accordingly.

methods.name: handleLogin
methods.description: Handles the login process with selected organization and password, manages navigation upon success.
